meta.title: Ondra Spoken Style
meta.description: Catchphrases, sentence-final particles, half-finished sentences and punctuation habits — all shaped here, and only by adding. Nothing is inserted until the pool holds at least twelve phrases: three catchphrases turn into a broken record within two turns. Omitting a subject only drops the closing particle, never a clause, and particles are only ever removed — adding them belongs to the model, because the persona ships a whitelist. Zero typos is baked into the type: faking clumsiness would require changing the type first.
